name: anchor: access isolation and privilege changes
description: anchor#302 on the deployed build. IDOR: Globex (another Organization of the Product), another Product's key, an Organization API key sent as a Product key and the platform session can't read, delete, list, assign or remove roles on Acme's folder, read or delete Acme's custom role, or evaluate there; Dan's role and access stay as they were. Privileges: emptying, restoring and replacing Dan's role, a custom role on the resource (never above it) and emptying it, removing Dan from Acme and rejoining (the resource role is gone) each apply to the next decision. Generator: echopoint-investigation/gen_access_isolation.py.
